description:
Decision (owner, 2026-10-09): option 1. Delete the `author_label_prefix` lookup and hard-code the claude exclusion, so the reviewer-diversity rule keeps its current effect (claude-family reviewers are skipped where the tier allows) without a label any agent could set to steer reviewer choice. Record the decision in docs/operations/oracle-review-v2.md. The muse items (oracle-muse-invalid-verdict-output-20261009, oracle-self-attested-file-list-reviewers-20261008) can proceed on this basis.

Why: the label is a reviewer-steering lever that any agent holding the token can set, so it does not tell the oracle who wrote the change. Inferring the family from commit trailers or the PR author is impossible: AGENTS.md forbids agent attribution trailers, and every PR author is joeharris76. Options not chosen: apply labels from PR tooling (still settable by any agent), or keep the lookup and document that only claude authors are covered.

Background. The oracle skips reviewers of the same family as the PR's author (`selection.excluded_families`, _project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/selection.py:60-64), reading `author-family:<family>` labels and falling back to `default_author_family: claude` (.github/oracle-reviewers.yml). On 2026-10-09 the repository had no `author-family:*` labels and nothing applies one, so every PR is treated as claude-authored. Tier orders: .github/oracle-reviewers.yml:103-105 (opus is diversity-exempt at very-high). Found while running oracle canaries #2842 and #2845, which needed hand-made labels.

Guardrails. Never weaken the required oracle-review check. The tier order and allowed tiers still apply. Very-high tier for any change to the reviewer package or policy.
